goal: Raise mean individual score while reducing zero/under500frequency and preserving effective ranged play.

hypotheses.situation: Low-level melee hero, visible enemy pressure, weak local allied cover
hypotheses.belief: Our melee9/13zeroes; late ordinal5eight/tenzeroes. Availability often forces these heroes.
hypotheses.skill: Farm behind allied creeps; retreat before repeated lethal engagements; choose reachable low-risk XP opportunities.

strategy.when: Public class/range and visible local power show a disadvantaged engagement

hypotheses.guards: Do not hardcode actor slot or opponent identity. Preserve killing blows when safely reachable.
hypotheses.validation: Actual reach/XP-radius fixtures and responsive mixed rosters with late-drafted melee exposure; score+zero-rate+hero/creepXP, not deaths alone.

hypotheses.situation: Alive/healthy outside keep, no selected target and no visible progress for a bounded period
hypotheses.belief: Source-reconstructed low-score routes repeatedly advance to enemy base; healthy field droughts recur even with few/no deaths.
hypotheses.skill: Reevaluate public lane/visible-wave destination and clear stale crossed-route commitment when its purpose is unproductive.

strategy.when: Public no-target/progress timer expires with safe alternatives

hypotheses.guards: BASIC has no raw XP input. Use validated public proxies such as target absence, landed-hit history, level/gold changes and visible waves. Avoid claiming that gold/hit changes equal XP. Bound oscillation and preserve emergency defense.
hypotheses.validation: Replay correspondence and public observation fixtures; exact hit/route changes; independent mean score and no-XP intervals, whole-game responsiveness.

hypotheses.situation: Choice between nearby hero/creep earnings and lengthy structure engagement
hypotheses.belief: Khors basic structure damage19/game versus ours8466, with more hero/creepXP. Our objective-biased routes can win with zero points. Clean first-draft controls still favor ours, so global structure avoidance is not established.
hypotheses.skill: Compare feasible hero/creep actions against objective return and travel time; preserve decisive500XPgod finishes.

strategy.when: Public reachable XP opportunities compete with a low-value structure route

hypotheses.guards: Do not prolong a game when marginal XP<200/minute. Avoid copying opponent aggregates as fixed priorities. Prior Richard siege and reward-finisher failures remain rejected.
hypotheses.validation: Score-centered mixed-roster A/B stratified by hero availability and color; no promotion from win rate or one rival gap alone.

hypotheses.situation: Recovered/shopped at keep with a ready scroll and a safe useful friendly destination
hypotheses.belief: Khors128outbound completions/39 appearances versus ours130/75, but also57keep-to-keep completions and23interruptions.
hypotheses.skill: Use a destination outside keep to rejoin reachable farming or combat sooner.

strategy.when: Public safe destination meaningfully shortens productive travel

hypotheses.guards: Keep existing channel lock, no redundant keep recall, and reserve policy unless independently disproved.
hypotheses.validation: Accepted endpoint/HP/return-to-XP events and fresh point comparison; more portal starts alone are not success.

hypotheses.situation: An ability is ready and target is selected, but target reach may exceed that ability
hypotheses.belief: Ours has~579out-of-range rejections/game versus6.46khors; our R_combat lacks an explicit ability range guard. Rejected casts do not establish lost mana or opportunity.
hypotheses.skill: Check current-engine ability geometry and select a reachable target when beneficial.

strategy.when: Public target/ability geometry passes a validated cast-affordance test

hypotheses.guards: Earlier independent spell-pressure confirmation failed; do not repeat it unchanged or equate fewer rejected calls with improved score.
hypotheses.validation: Accepted damage/healing and alternative-action outcomes, then independent hosted score; all sources and failures preserved.

evaluation: A future implementation needs public-input semantic binding, source/IR round trip, runtime checks, fresh baseline comparisons, both colors and naturally constrained drafts. Report whole-game-correlated uncertainty, personal mean, zero and under500rates, low-case XP, and gaps to khors/Richard/Jordan. No new games scheduled by this analysis.

score_objective.guard: Optimize final individual score. Longer games, survival, damage, portal count or XP alone are not advancement gates. Raw XP diagnostics must not leak into live BASIC inputs.
